rationale_md: France enters this Group I clash as overwhelming favorites, backed by a substantial 330-point Elo rating advantage that reflects the gulf in class between the 2022 World Cup runners-up and a developing Iraqi side. The model's assessment giving France better than three-in-four odds to secure all three points aligns with their recent tournament pedigree and superior squad depth across every position. Iraq will need a near-perfect defensive performance and clinical finishing on the counter to pull off what would rank among the biggest upsets of the 2026 World Cup group stage.
